column1: requirement_sentence
The telemetry subsystem shall transmit atmospheric sensor readings to the ground station via the UHF antenna interface.
The flight management computer shall calculate the optimal ascent trajectory within 50 milliseconds of sensor state update.
The emergency braking controller shall actuate the hydraulic caliper within 10 milliseconds of deceleration command assertion.
The powertrain electronic control unit shall maintain engine idle speed within plus or minus 50 revolutions per minute.
The SCADA gateway shall poll all field RTU devices across the Modbus serial connection every 500 milliseconds.
The avionics display unit shall render pitch, roll, and yaw angles on the primary flight director screen.
The safety interlocking system shall de-energize the main contactor upon detection of an open enclosure interlock switch.
The satellite communications payload shall route transponder channel signals to the active phased array receiver.
The industrial robotics arm controller shall halt trajectory interpolation if joint torque exceeds safety envelope thresholds.
The automated train protection system shall enforce speed restriction profiles using balise transmission telegrams.
The environmental control system shall regulate cabin air pressure according to the barometric altimeter schedule.
The power distribution management unit shall shed non-essential electrical loads upon primary bus voltage sag.
The guidance navigation and control software shall fuse inertial measurement unit data with GPS satellite ephemeris.
The mission computer shall log all fault code exceptions into non-volatile radiation-hardened flash memory.
The automated life support subsystem shall monitor ambient oxygen partial pressure and sound an audible alarm if below 19.5%.
The digital engine controller shall trim fuel flow metering valves during high-altitude cruise conditions.
The remote terminal unit shall buffer up to 10,000 sequence of events records during upstream communication outages.
The redundant flight control computer shall arbitrate actuator command authority using tri-modular voter logic.
The subsea blowout preventer control pod shall actuate hydraulic shear rams upon loss of acoustic signal telemetry.
The automated automated guided vehicle fleet manager shall dispatch transport vehicles using topological graph routing.
The nuclear reactor protection system shall initiate emergency control rod insertion upon over-temperature trip detection.
The optical sensor payload shall calibrate infrared focal plane array pixel gain during shutter calibration cycles.
The spacecraft electrical power system shall regulate solar array battery charging using maximum power point tracking.
The automated baggage handling conveyor shall divert luggage containers based on optical barcode label scanner reads.
The autonomous driving perception stack shall project LiDAR point cloud returns onto camera image coordinates.
The active phased array radar shall steer RF beam azimuth and elevation electronically without mechanical gimbals.
The cryogenic propellant management system shall vent boil-off boil-off gas when tank ullage pressure exceeds limits.
The distributed control system shall execute PID regulation algorithms for distillation column reflux flow rates.
The flight data recorder shall survive continuous exposure to 1100 degrees Celsius fire for 60 minutes.
The maritime navigation system shall interface with the automatic identification system transponder over NMEA 0183.
The weapons release management system shall require dual consenting arming signals prior to ordnance release.
The space station robotic arm shall track grapple fixture visual targets using stereo photogrammetry.
The electronic warfare suite shall classify detected RF emitter signatures against a threat library.
The turbine governor shall modulate inlet steam control valves to prevent generator overspeed conditions.
The satellite attitude determination subsystem shall determine spacecraft orientation using autonomous star tracker cameras.
The uninterruptible power supply shall transfer load to battery backup within 4 milliseconds of grid utility loss.
The collision avoidance radar shall generate acoustic traffic alerts when time to closest approach drops below 25 seconds.
The industrial gas turbine monitoring unit shall track exhaust gas temperature thermocouple spreads.
The launch vehicle stage separation system shall fire pyrotechnic ordnance bolts upon timer expiration.
The autonomous underwater vehicle shall navigate pre-programmed waypoints using Doppler velocity log dead reckoning.
